parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Approximately 200 cm 3 of hot water is poured into beaker A and, after a short while, the thermometer reading rises to the value shown in Fig. 2.1. Read, and record in the top row of Table 2.1, this temperature θ at time t = 0.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Approximately 100 cm 3 of hot water is poured into beaker B . The thermometer reading rises to the value shown in Fig. 2.2. Read, and record in the top row of Table 2.1, this temperature θ at time t = 0.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The temperatures θ of the thermometer in each experiment at times t = 30 s, 60 s, 90 s, 120 s, 150 s and 180 s are shown in Table 2.1.
